BTST BTST (आज ख़रीदें, कल बेचें)

Buy Today, Sell Tomorrow: selling shares before they reach your demat account, which carries a risk if the seller fails to deliver.

हिंदी में: BTST (आज ख़रीदें, कल बेचें)

आज ख़रीदें, कल बेचें: डीमैट खाते में आने से पहले शेयर बेचना; विक्रेता के डिलीवरी न देने पर इसमें जोखिम है।

How it is used in the lessons

Selling shares you bought yesterday before they reach your demat (BTST) is risky: if the seller fails to deliver, you can face an auction penalty.
